verdict.rationale: Medusa documents its own built-in customization framework that lets developers "extend, customize, and own every commerce workflow" without reinventing core commerce logic, which covers checkout as a workflow. It also has Cart Module and storefront development guides, and its headless storefront model implies developer-owned checkout fields and branding. The evidence never shows checkout-specific extension points such as hooks for validation or a discount/promotion API, so only the general extensibility of the core is supported. Missing for 10: documented checkout-specific extension points, discount/promotion customization evidence, custom validation-logic hooks, checkout field and branding customization docs, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can customize checkout — fields, branding, discounts, and validation logic — through supported extension points rather than forking checkout

citations.quote: Extend, customize, and own every commerce workflow.
Medusa is a commerce platform with a built-in framework for customization that allows you to build custom commerce applications without reinventing core commerce logic.
